about: Codes and menu paths to forward the calls you don't answer to another number (conditional call forwarding), US and Canada. Replace [number] with the 10-digit destination number. Source: https://odilelabs.com/forwarding (Odile Labs), checked October 2026; VoIP steps from each provider's own help pages, read 12 October 2026.

mobile_carriers.notes: The 10 in the no-answer code is the ring time in seconds; without it the carrier waits about 20 seconds.

*71 covers no answer and busy; it rings 3 to 6 times first and Verizon has no shorter setting. On an iPhone, turn off Live Voicemail first (Settings, Apps, Phone, Live Voicemail): Verizon says it stops *71 from working.
Visible's *71 forwards only while you're on another call; it cannot forward only unanswered calls.
Try the AT&T codes; if they are refused, the carrier's support sets it.

landlines.notes: Stay on the line 5 seconds; it forwards after 4 rings. With Rogers voicemail on, ask Rogers to switch it.
On newer Telus accounts, Telus sets the number for you.

voip.steps: App: Settings, Phone, Call handling, Edit, Work hours (and After hours), Missed calls, Forward to external number.
Admin console, the ring group, Configuration, Unanswered calls, Forward the caller, then the number. Forwards after 30 seconds.

voip.notes: Cannot forward only missed calls; linked numbers all ring at once.

voip.steps: Admin Portal, Phone System, Extensions, edit the extension, Call Forwarding, Follow Me: your extension first, then the number.
Voice portal, Users, the user, Actions, Voice Settings, Forwarding, Call forwarding (unanswered): the number and the rings.
voip.notes: Admins only; covers direct calls, not call groups.

voip.steps: Settings, Phone, Voicemail and forwarding, When a call goes unanswered, Forward to External Contacts.
voip.notes: Add the number as an external contact first; an admin may need to allow forwarding outside Zoom.

voip.steps: In the number's call flow: a Ring users step, then Forward call to the number, then Publish.
Admin Console, Users, the user, Call forwarding rules, When user does not answer, Forward directly to a custom number.
Settings, Calls, Call handling and forwarding, If unanswered: the number and the ring time in seconds.
Web client, Settings, Call Forwarding, Unanswered calls, External number, with the seconds.
voip.notes: Calls through a ring group or queue skip these personal rules.
Cannot send only unanswered calls to an outside number.

check_it_worked: Call the line from another phone and let it ring; after a few rings the forwarded number should answer.
anything_else: Grasshopper, Dialpad, GoTo, Spectrum, Comcast and others: ask the provider for 'forward on no answer' to the number.
